bash_commands: git ls-files; cat src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "h \|02d\|duration\|divmod" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./src/trailhead/\(plan\|report\).py"

python - <<'EOF'

s = s.replace('''        whole, minutes = divmod(round(hours * 60), 60)
        lines.append(f"Day {day}: points {first}-{last}, {whole}h {minutes:02d}m")''', '''        lines.append(f"Day {day}: points {first}-{last}, {format_duration(hours)}")''')
